primary_justification: Manual review found that the source-only rows are real current-period loan positions, not aggregate/header/subtotal/comparative rows. The source rows include issuer, first-lien loan terms, par, maturity, acquisition date, rate/spread, fair value, and percent-of-net-assets evidence. Current production output search did not find same-CIK/date Dye & Durham, Elements Finco, or Lynx BidCo rows. Because prior Sixth Street packets show the same unresolved parser/staging failure and the available evidence does not isolate a narrow safe production mechanism, adding a broad hierarchy parser rule would risk admitting non-position rows.
residual_risk: The blocker remains unresolved in production until a developer traces the Sixth Street extraction/staging path and adds a targeted fix with false-positive coverage. This verdict does not clear the source reconciliation by suppression; it escalates a real missing-position defect.
